home.title: Is your neighborhood flood-ready?
home.subtitle: Any US ZIP or map pin. We query FEMA’s National Flood Hazard Layer (NFHL) nationwide, plus live NWS alerts at that point — not an insurance quote.
home.hint: Enter any 5-digit US ZIP or click a map pin to see FEMA zone + risk factors.
home.disclaimer: Educational only. FEMA NFHL effective data when available. Not an official flood determination for insurance or lending.
home.lookupError: Could not look up risk. Try another ZIP.
home.nwsNone: No active flood-related NWS alerts for the current scope.
home.femaFallback: Using demo + NWS (NFHL unavailable at this point)

about.title: About FloodGuard
about.body: FloodGuard is the flood product in the TxBizFinder Intelligence suite. FEMA NFHL is national — look up any US ZIP. Started in Texas; coverage is USA where effective flood maps exist.
about.sources: FEMA NFHL MapServer (Flood Hazard Zones, layer 28) nationwide, NWS alerts by point/state (api.weather.gov), Zippopotam geocode. Map pins are sample metros for browsing. Next: USGS gauges and OpenFEMA claims.
about.suite: Sister apps: TxBizFinder, PermitRadar, ChannelWatch, Emissions Sentinel, PowerPulse, MapHub.
